purpose: 四主题大图鉴入口，按确认布局接入代码

entries.name: 市井朱红
entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create the PRODUCTION TRANSPARENT ICON for the larger collection entrance approved by the user. Image 1 is the approved CELADON HEADER LAYOUT reference: use the large collection BOOK at its upper left ONLY as a size/proportion and oversized-label design reference. DO NOT reproduce the header, logo, background, settings or progress UI. Image 2 is the EXISTING SINGLE ICON to edit; preserve its theme identity, materials, book illustration and premium hotpot food.
Output exactly ONE complete standalone open-book collection icon on a true transparent square canvas. The book pages show snowflake-marbled WAGYU BEEF ROLLS on the left and thin MATSUTAKE SLICES on the right. No shellfish or shells. Keep the current food and warm ivory pages. Upgrade the integrated lower-front button PLAQUE: make it substantially WIDER, about 75–80% of the whole visible book width, like the large book in the approved header. Its exact text is "图鉴" in Simplified Chinese. Make these two characters MUCH LARGER, bold, upright, high contrast, beautifully crafted and immediately readable on a phone: the two characters together occupy about 55–60% of total book width. Correct strokes, no extra letters or words. Place the plaque across the lower front without obscuring the food. Preserve the short bookmark below it. The larger plaque is part of the book rather than a separate floating button.
Polished dimensional Chinese casual-game asset, broad readable shapes, restrained fine ornament, clean silhouette and consistent upper-left light. The food remains appetizing and elegant. Generous transparent safe margin around the complete icon, NO clipping, NO white edge halos or loose background specks. ONE icon, no grid, no UI mockup, no scenery, no watermark.
Preserve the festive vermilion lacquer cover, emerald binding/bookmark and antique gold cloud corner guards from Image 2. Oversized plaque: deep emerald lacquer, warm antique gold rim and very large embossed gold 图鉴 lettering.
